questions.question:
Select the number that can replace the question mark in the following series.

26, 34, 41, 46, 56, ?

Read the given statements and conclusions carefully and decide which of the / conclusions logically follows from the statements.

**Statement:**

Physical abuse is apparent, so it is easy to accept it, but mental abuse does not appear, so we keep denying it.

**Conclusions:**

I. We reject to what we cannot see.

II. It is easy to accept what we see.

options.text: Conclusion I and II both follows
Either conclusion I or Conclusion II follows

questions.solution:
Conclusion 1: This follows, because we generally believe what we see only.

Conclusion 2: This follows, because we accept what we see.

Hence, “both conclusion 1 and conclusion 2” follow.

I. All doors are floors.

II Some floors are tiles.

III. All tiles are paints.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some floors are paints.

II. Some doors are tiles.

Hence, “only conclusion 1” follow.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number.

7 : 98 ∷ 11 : ?
questions.solution:
The pattern followed is,

For, 

7: 98

7: 7² + 7² 

Similarly,

11:?

11: 11² + 11²

11: **242**

‘242’ is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number.

Hence, “242” is the correct answer.
